Everything above about "FLORIDA 300X THE CASH" comes from the Florida Lottery's own published numbers. We only do the counting.
5048.headline: Top prizes are still unclaimed

5055.body:
"EMERALD MINE 9X" is in the last part of its run, with only a small slice of its tickets still unsold. Late in a run, a game is worth a look when prizes outlast tickets. Early on, the prize design matters most. Here, tickets and top prizes are running out at about the same rate.

The table below shows the full count for "EMERALD MINE 9X", with every prize level included.
5055.headline: Where this game is in its run

5057.body:
"EASY MONEY" is past the halfway point of its run, with about a quarter of its tickets still unsold. Late in a run, a game is worth a look when prizes outlast tickets. Early on, the prize design matters most. Here, a larger share of the top prizes is left than of the tickets, which is a good sign.

If you play "EASY MONEY" often, bookmark this page. The write-up is updated with each morning's data.
5057.headline: How far along this game is

5059.body:
About two-thirds of the tickets for "THE CASH WHEEL" are sold. The top prize count has held, with two of six still unclaimed. The number of tickets printed is fixed, so that is a plain good sign.

The numbers for "THE CASH WHEEL" are recalculated every morning, and this page changes with them.
5059.headline: No new top prize claims

5060.body:
"FIND THE 7S" paid out its last $50,000 prize six months ago. The ticket still advertises it because printed tickets never change. Prize tables do change, and the biggest prize listed today is $10,000.

The numbers for "FIND THE 7S" are recalculated every morning, and this page changes with them.
5060.headline: No top prizes remain

5063.body:
The most common win left on "CA$H IN HAND" is $10. The second biggest prize left is $100,000, and six of those are still unclaimed. The prize table is what defines a scratcher, and this page counts every level of it.

The numbers for "CA$H IN HAND" will change a little by tomorrow, and this page will change with them.
5063.headline: Prize table details
